how: Recorded by the reviewer as the dedicated test OS user with a temporary HOME and CODEX_HOME (Asia/Singapore). Ran one real codex exec turn on a ChatGPT Pro subscription account with a synthetic prompt asking for a one-word reply. The account reported only a weekly primary window; secondary was null.

files.rollout.jsonl: The native turn_context of the turn and the quota-bearing token_count that followed it. Unused turn_context payload fields and the account credit balance in rate_limits were omitted; other values are unchanged.
